# CSP Journal

> Academic journal publishing peer-reviewed research on strategic perspectives, geopolitics, and international relations in the Caucasus, Central Asia, and surrounding regions.

Caucasus Strategic Perspectives (CSP Journal) is a biannual academic publication focusing on sovereignty, foreign policy, and geopolitical dynamics in Azerbaijan, the South Caucasus, Central Asia, and their relationships with major powers including Russia and Ukraine. The journal features contributions from international scholars and experts in strategic studies.

## Key Topics

- Caucasus Strategic Perspectives
- South Caucasus geopolitics
- Azerbaijan foreign policy
- Central Asia strategic studies
- International relations
- Sovereignty and non-alignment
- Russia-Ukraine dynamics
- Non-Aligned Movement
- Peer-review process
- Academic publishing ethics
- Regional security studies
- Geopolitical analysis
- Strategic research
- Caucasus region
- Academic journal management
